subject: Security acceptance runway and evidence visibility for BlueWave pilot
messages:
From: Jose Santos <j.santos@bluewave.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodelabs.com>
Cc: sec@bluewave.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security acceptance runway for pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — BlueWave is excited to move the pilot to a controlled production window. Before we lock dates, the security team asked for a clear MAP-style breakdown of the compliance gates (SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire responses, DPA carveouts and data retention windows) and an explicit timeline for when evidence will be available for review.

Can you share a single-page plan (or spreadsheet) that shows:
- Which SOC 2 artifacts we can access for an evaluation snapshot vs. what requires attestation
- Expected delivery date for completed SIG/CAIQ answers and open items
- Proposed DPA redline with retention windows called out (30/90/365) and whether Redwood can support shorter windows for the pilot

I attached a short scope summary for context.

Appreciate it,
Jose

Attachment: BlueWave-scope.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodelabs.com>
To: Jose Santos <j.santos@bluewave.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodelabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodelabs.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security acceptance runway for pilot

Jose — thanks for the note and the scope. I pulled together a short MAP snapshot and an evidence plan (attached) to make review easier. High level:

MAP snapshot (summary):
- Week 0 (5/10): MAP v1 delivered to BlueWave (this email + MAP-v1.xlsx) and SOC 2 evidence index (redwood-soc2-evidence-map.pdf)
- Week 1 (5/17): SIG/CAIQ answers shared with BlueWave (marked: final vs. vendor-qna)
- Week 2 (5/24): DPA redline and retention options for pilot (suggested: 90-day retention for pilot logs, 365-day for core data)
- Week 3 (6/01): Evidence review meeting and gap list (action items and owners)

Notes on SOC 2:
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II; for evaluations we can provide the evidence index and redacted artifacts (control narratives, relevant test-logs) for the pilot review. Full attestation letter requires our auditor release (standard process).
- For the pilot we recommend a short evidence package — we’ve indicated which items are "snapshot-ok" in the PDF.

DPA / retention:
- Laura will propose the DPA redline with explicit pilot retention windows. We can support a 90-day retention on request for limited datasets; production SLA will default to 365 days unless an org-level carveout is approved.

Next steps: please confirm whether BlueWave needs an accelerated SOC 2 artifact pull (we can prioritize certain controls), and confirm availability for a 60-minute review on 5/25 or 5/26.

I attached: MAP-v1.xlsx and redwood-soc2-evidence-map.pdf.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-soc2-evidence-map.pdf (pdf)

Adding a legal lens here.

Naomi — I reviewed the MAP and the DPA ask. A few clarifications to keep it tight for the pilot:
- Pilot retention windows should be enumerated per data class (logs, PII, derived embeddings). We should propose explicit deletion and verification steps for any 90-day retention carveout.
- For SIG/CAIQ, we will share vendor answers but flag items that require compensating controls (I’ll mark these in the CAIQ workbook).
- I attached a proposed redline to the DPA with a pilot clause (dpa-proposed-redline.docx).

Recommendation: include an acceptance checklist row in MAP-v1.xlsx that requires BlueWave sign-off on the evidence snapshot before the pilot start date — avoids downstream disputes.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: dpa-proposed-redline.docx (docx)
